tips.title: Tips to save
tips.fridge: Keep the fridge at 3–5 °C and its door seal clean
tips.aircon: Set the air conditioner to 26 °C and clean its filter every month
tips.standby: Switch off chargers and TVs at the plug when you go out
tips.shower: A shorter shower saves water and the water heater's electricity

manual.title: Water & electricity use
manual.body: The meters of your unit are read by the building's staff once a month, so there is no daily chart
manual.bills: Each month's reading and the meter photo are on your bill
